Implement Flutter ResetPasswordScreen in mobile/lib/features/auth/screens/reset_password_screen.dart only.
- StatefulWidget ResetPasswordScreen({super.key, this.token}).
- Input fields: Token/Code (if not provided in route), New Password, Confirm New Password.
- Password validators: min 8 characters, confirmation matching check, obscureText toggle.
- 'Reset Password' button with loading indicator.
- Calls POST /api/auth/recovery/reset-password with token and newPassword.
- SnackBar / Dialog on success and navigation to LoginScreen.
